source.note: migration file is uncommitted at contract time; sha256 below is authoritative

backup.production_rule: single create-or-replace of one trigger-only function whose only change is the webhook URL; no table, column, policy, trigger or privilege is touched, and the previous definition is one migration away, so the 2026-09-10 D-061 drill set (restore-proven, 86/86 ledger rows) is an adequate restore point - no fresh backup is taken for this release

stop_conditions: trigger automation_outbox_dispatch_w01 is absent from public.automation_outbox before apply
any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
this release must not activate any n8n workflow: D-022 still holds and every Cascade workflow stays inactive

forward_verification.name: trigger_still_attached
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 from pg_trigger t join pg_class c on c.oid = t.tgrelid join pg_proc p on p.oid = t.tgfoid where not t.tgisinternal and c.relname = 'automation_outbox' and p.proname = 'dispatch_w01_booking_requested'

forward_verification.name: dispatcher_not_client_executable
forward_verification.query: select not has_function_privilege('anon','public.dispatch_w01_booking_requested()','execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.dispatch_w01_booking_requested()','execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role','public.dispatch_w01_booking_requested()','execute')

feature_flags.name: PROVIDER_SEND_APPROVED
feature_flags.required_state: must NOT gain CH-W01. This release only changes where W01 would post; per D-022 every Cascade workflow stays inactive and only CH-S01 (D-053) and CH-W04 (D-056) are approved to send.

feature_flags.name: cascade n8n workflow state
feature_flags.required_state: CH-W01 remains inactive in both n8n instances after apply; activation is a separate, explicitly approved step

rollback.safe_until: any time; the dispatcher swallows delivery errors and the automation_outbox row remains the durable retry source either way

steps.name: repoint_back_to_shared_n8n
steps.action: re-apply supabase/migrations/20260824045800_dispatch_w01_to_n8n.sql, which recreates the same function with the n8n.rocloyd.com URL and re-creates the trigger
